[SWS_TcpIp_00363] ⌈If TcpIp_IsConnectionReady() is called and a security as-
sociation is configured, the module shall:
• check if socket exists and is bound to an assigned local address.
• check if the provided remote address has a corresponding physical address.
• check if a security association is established for this socket.
If all checks are successful, the function shall return TCPIP_E_OK.⌋
